description: The Stone map sends zero to the empty set and one to the whole space, and preserves binary meets, binary joins, and complements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap_laws.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap ⊥ = ∅ ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap ⊤ = Set.univ ∧
      (∀ (a b : B),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap (a ⊓ b) =
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap a ∩ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap b) ∧
        (∀ (a b : B),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap (a ⊔ b) =
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap a ∪ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap b) ∧
          ∀ (a : B),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap aᶜ = (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap a)ᶜ
